children: Deutsche Bank Aktiengesellschaft (XETR:DBK) boosted buybacks and raised U.S. prime lending rates while launching a regulated crypto gateway—added to the EU MiCA register—to support BTC, ETH and select stablecoins, eye tokenized products and an EU custody license.
: Deutsche Bank (DBK) repurchased 2,192,965 shares on 7–11 Sep 2026, raising total buyback since 25 Aug 2026 to 5,121,715; trades executed on Xetra, Cboe, Turquoise and Aquis.
Deutsche Bank Aktiengesellschaft Added To EU MiCA Register
: Deutsche Bank Aktiengesellschaft (DBK) was added to the EU MiCA crypto-provider register, formally listing DBK as a crypto-service provider under the EU Markets in Crypto-Assets framework.
Deutsche Bank Supports Crypto At Launch
: Deutsche Bank (DBK) will support Bitcoin, Ether and select stablecoins (USDC, EURC, AllUnity EUR) at launch; plans tokenized products later and aims for EU MiCA custody license in October.
Deutsche Bank Unveils Digital Assets Gateway
: Deutsche Bank (DBK) unveiled a regulated, secure gateway for digital assets aimed at asset managers, hedge funds, custodians, brokers and corporates; rollout will take years before revenue begins.
DBK NY Branch Raises Prime Lending Rate
: Deutsche Bank Aktiengesellschaft (DBK) says its New York Branch and Deutsche Bank Trust Company Americas will raise prime lending rate from 6.75% to 7.00%, effective Sept 17, 2026.
